# Learn from corrections (Bayram Annakov)

Captures your corrections during sessions and turns them into CLAUDE.md rules you approve.

- Source: https://github.com/BayramAnnakov/claude-reflect
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BayramAnnakov/claude-reflect/main/SKILL.md
- Author: Bayram Annakov
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/learn-from-corrections-bayram-annakov-bf9dad1a

Hooks watch for corrections such as "no, use X" or "remember:" and add them to a queue. Running /reflect lets you review the queued items and write the ones you approve into the right place: global or project CLAUDE.md, rules files or memory. Other commands scan past sessions for missed learnings, preview changes, suggest skills from repeated patterns, or clear the queue.

**Try asking:**
- "/reflect"
- "/reflect --scan-history"
- "Remember: we use pnpm, not npm, in this repo"
